architectural_units.name: Frontend
architectural_units.description: The frontend is the mobile application developed with Flutter that acts as the presentation layer, managing the graphical interface, navigation, and user interaction.

architectural_units.name: Backend
architectural_units.description: The backend is the software responsible for processing user requests, business logic, data persistence, and integration with external services.

architectural_units.name: Domain Layer (Backend)
architectural_units.description: Contains the purest business logic of the system, as well as domain models and repository interfaces, independent of Django, the database, or any external service.

architectural_units.name: Application Layer (Backend)
architectural_units.description: Includes the system's use cases, which orchestrate business logic and define the flow of operations, acting as an intermediary between the domain and infrastructure.

architectural_units.name: Infrastructure Layer (Backend)
architectural_units.description: Responsible for interaction with the exterior, implementing Django HTTP views, repositories that access the database via ORM, and adapters for external services.

architectural_units.name: Presentation Layer (Frontend)
architectural_units.description: Manages the application state and communication with the user interface using Bloc/Cubit.

architectural_units.name: Domain Layer (Frontend)
architectural_units.description: Contains the business logic, with use cases, entities, and repositories defined as interfaces.

architectural_units.name: Data Layer (Frontend)
architectural_units.description: Responsible for data access, including backend calls, data transformation, and concrete implementation of repositories.

architectural_units.name: Authentication Service
architectural_units.description: Service responsible for managing user authentication, including delegated login and OTP generation.

architectural_units.name: AI Service
architectural_units.description: External service used for generating intelligent response suggestions for reviews.

architectural_units.name: Flutter
architectural_units.description: Framework used for the development of the mobile application.

architectural_units.name: Django
architectural_units.description: Backend framework used for building the REST API.

architectural_units.name: MySQL
architectural_units.description: Relational database management system used for data persistence.

architectural_units.name: Gemini
architectural_units.description: AI service integrated for generating review responses.

architectural_units.name: ChatGPT
architectural_units.description: AI service integrated for generating review responses.

architectural_units.name: REST
architectural_units.description: Communication protocol used between frontend and backend.

architectural_units.name: HTTP
architectural_units.description: Communication protocol used for API requests.
The frontend is the mobile application developed with Flutter that acts as the presentation layer [...] and of performing the necessary requests to the back-end to obtain or modify information.
The communication between the front-end and the back-end is carried out through a REST API, using JSON format messages for both requests and responses.
The back-end integrates several external services, such as artificial intelligence services (Gemini or ChatGPT) and authentication services.
The persistence of data is carried out through a MySQL relational database, managed through the Django ORM.

architectural_units.name: JSON
architectural_units.description: The communication between the front-end and the back-end is carried out through a REST API, using JSON format messages for both requests and responses.

patterns.name: Client-Server
patterns.description: The system follows a client-server architecture where the mobile application (frontend) makes requests to a server (backend) that processes them.

patterns.name: Hexagonal Architecture
patterns.description: The backend follows the Hexagonal Architecture (Ports and Adapters) pattern, which allows separating business logic from the framework and infrastructure technologies.

patterns.name: Repository Pattern
patterns.description: Isolates data access and simplifies the use of the ORM in use cases.

patterns.name: Factory Pattern
patterns.description: Used to dynamically instantiate artificial intelligence services according to the system configuration.

patterns.name: Clean Architecture
patterns.description: The frontend follows the principles of Clean Architecture, separating responsibilities into Presentation, Domain, and Data layers.
